# Harness protection claims

Each row is one hook event or extension surface Guard connects to. **If Guard fails** says what happens to a state-changing action when the Guard runtime cannot answer; actions that continue anyway are named under **Not covered**. **Claim** is what the project states about the row:

- `configured`: Guard installs and answers this event. No live run on an exact harness version is on record.
- `transport_ready`, `live_block_proven`, `live_allow_proven`: proven on the Guard build, harness version and platform named in the row, until its expiry time.
- `partial`: proven with the stated limitations.
- `observe_only`: Guard records the event and cannot stop it.
- `unsupported`: the harness exposes no boundary Guard can enforce.
- `stale`: the evidence has expired. Treat the row as `configured`.

The machine-readable copy is [`generated/harness-claims.v1.json`](generated/harness-claims.v1.json).

## Not covered

Rows that do not stop the action when Guard fails, and the blind spots each row names.

| Harness | Event | Surface | If Guard fails | Blind spots and limitations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| codex | `PreToolUse`: `Bash`, `Read`, `mcp__*` | foreground | Stops the action | A source declaration does not prove that a live Codex process honored a deny response. |
| codex | `PreToolUse`: `apply_patch` | foreground | Stops the action | Edits the model applies without an apply_patch tool call are not visible to Guard. PostToolUse does not match apply_patch, so the written result is not observed. A source declaration does not prove that a live Codex process honored a deny response. |
| codex | `PreToolUse`: `Write`, `Edit`, `MultiEdit` | foreground | Stops the action | Codex applies its own file edits through apply_patch; these names cover only tools that report them, and no live Codex run on record shows a version that emits them. PostToolUse does not match these tools, so the written result is not observed. A source declaration does not prove that a live Codex process honored a deny response. |
| codex | `PermissionRequest` | foreground | Stops the action | Native approval UX and Guard evidence still require a live host/version check. |
| codex | `UserPromptSubmit` | foreground | Stops the action | Prompt screening does not prove downstream model or host request rewriting. |
| codex | `PostToolUse` | foreground | Records only | Native post-tool observation does not prove model-visible output replacement. |
| claude-code | `PreToolUse` | foreground | Stops the action | Sessions started with --bare, or with a --setting-sources or Agent SDK settingSources list that leaves out user, never load Guard's hooks and are unprotected. Background sessions (claude --bg) load the same hooks but are not qualified with Guard. A review waits at Claude Code's confirmation prompt until someone attaches to the session. |
| claude-code | `PermissionRequest` | foreground | Stops the action | Guard adds pending review context and defers to Claude's own permission dialog; the native PreToolUse verdict remains the decision boundary. |
| claude-code | `PostToolUse` | foreground | Records only | Native PostToolUse is not a general model-visible result replacement boundary. |
| claude-code | `UserPromptSubmit` | foreground | Lets the action continue | Prompt screening does not prove downstream model or host request rewriting. |
| opencode | `shell` | foreground | No enforcement | Prompt content is not currently surfaced through hooks. File read/write events bypass Guard unless OpenCode permission rules block them. |
| opencode | `mcp_tool` | foreground | No enforcement | Prompt content is not currently surfaced through hooks. File read/write events bypass Guard unless OpenCode permission rules block them. |
| opencode | `UserPromptSubmit` | foreground | No enforcement | Prompt content is not available through the declared OpenCode hooks. |
| copilot | `shell` | foreground | No enforcement | MCP tool calls routed through the VS Code extension are not visible to the CLI-level Guard hook. |
| copilot | `prompt` | foreground | No enforcement | MCP tool calls routed through the VS Code extension are not visible to the CLI-level Guard hook. |
| cursor | `beforeShellExecution` | editor | Stops the action | Cursor terminal actions outside an agent hook path remain outside this boundary. |
| cursor | `beforeMCPExecution` | editor | Stops the action | Only MCP traffic entering Cursor's declared hook surface is covered. |
| cursor | `beforeReadFile` | editor | Stops the action | Reads outside the Cursor hook path are not covered. |
| cursor | `preToolUse` | editor | Stops the action | Inline edits that bypass the declared Cursor hook are not covered. |
| cursor | `afterShellExecution` | editor | Records only | Observation does not block or undo the completed shell command. |
| cursor | `afterMCPExecution` | editor | Records only | Observation does not block or replace a result already returned by Cursor. |
| cursor | `UserPromptSubmit` | editor | No enforcement | Prompt submission is not surfaced through the declared Cursor hooks. |
| cursor | `*` | cli | No enforcement | Actions inside a Cursor CLI agent session are not claimed until a live CLI session shows Guard answering them. Running cursor-agent directly instead of the Guard shim skips the launch check. |
| cursor | `*` | cloud-agent | No enforcement | Cloud agents load the project .cursor/hooks.json but not the user hooks file, and no Guard runtime answers them there. |
| cursor | `*` | terminal | No enforcement | Commands typed into Cursor's built-in terminal outside an agent session bypass Guard. |
| cline | `PreToolUse` | foreground | Stops the action | Emergency-safe inspection actions can continue during Guard authority failure. JetBrains protection remains unverified until a live pre-tool deny proof is observed. |
| cline | `PreToolUse` | foreground | Stops the action | Plugin load and live pre-tool suppression still require an installed-host proof. |
| cline | `PostToolUse` | foreground | Records only | Native Cline PostToolUse is observation-only and cannot provide model-visible replacement. |
| cline | `PostToolUse` | foreground | Stops the action | Synthetic plugin canaries do not prove live Cline model-visible replacement. |
| cline | `UserPromptSubmit` | foreground | Records only | Prompt observation does not block submission or prove final model request redaction. |
| cline | `TaskStart` | foreground | Records only | Lifecycle observations do not establish a blocking boundary. |
| cline | `TaskError` | foreground | Records only | Lifecycle observations do not establish a blocking boundary. |
| cline | `SessionShutdown` | foreground | Records only | Lifecycle observations do not establish a blocking boundary. |
| gemini | `shell` | foreground | No enforcement | Prompt submission events and file read/write operations are not currently observable through the Gemini hook surface. |
| gemini | `mcp_tool` | foreground | No enforcement | Prompt submission events and file read/write operations are not currently observable through the Gemini hook surface. |
| hermes | `shell` | foreground | No enforcement | Hermes desktop and ACP entry paths may not register shell hooks; CLI and gateway honor hooks.pre_tool_call. |
| hermes | `mcp_tool` | foreground | No enforcement | Hermes desktop and ACP entry paths may not register shell hooks; CLI and gateway honor hooks.pre_tool_call. |
| hermes | `prompt` | foreground | No enforcement | Hermes desktop and ACP entry paths may not register shell hooks; CLI and gateway honor hooks.pre_tool_call. |
| openclaw | `mcp_tool` | foreground | No enforcement | Shell commands and prompt events are not currently observable. Guard only intercepts MCP tool calls via the proxy layer. |
| antigravity | `mcp_tool` | editor | No enforcement | Shell commands are not currently observable through the Antigravity hook surface. Guard intercepts extensions and MCP registrations via scan at launch time. |
| antigravity | `prompt` | editor | No enforcement | Shell commands are not currently observable through the Antigravity hook surface. Guard intercepts extensions and MCP registrations via scan at launch time. |
| kimi | `shell` | foreground | No enforcement | Tool output post-processing and inline edits applied without a tool call are not visible to Guard. Hooks run in parallel, so separate requests may be reviewed concurrently. |
| kimi | `prompt` | foreground | No enforcement | Tool output post-processing and inline edits applied without a tool call are not visible to Guard. Hooks run in parallel, so separate requests may be reviewed concurrently. |
| grok | `PreToolUse` | foreground | Stops the action | Post-tool events do not prevent an action that already executed. |
| grok | `UserPromptSubmit` | foreground | Lets the action continue | Auto-wake and subagent prompts are passive; Grok fails open if the hook process crashes or times out. |
| grok | `PostToolUse` | foreground | Records only | Post-tool observation does not block or replace model-visible output. |
| pi | `UserPromptSubmit` | foreground | Stops the action | Package installation and update flows happen outside the runtime extension bridge. |
| pi | `PreToolUse` | foreground | Stops the action | A present extension file alone does not prove Pi loaded it or suppressed a live tool call. |
| pi | `PostToolUse` | foreground | Stops the action | A synthetic extension canary does not prove live Pi model-visible replacement. |
| omp | `UserPromptSubmit` | foreground | Stops the action | Package installation and update flows happen outside the runtime extension bridge. |
| omp | `PreToolUse` | foreground | Stops the action | A present extension file alone does not prove live tool suppression. |
| omp | `PostToolUse` | foreground | Stops the action | A synthetic extension canary does not prove live model-visible replacement. |
| zcode | `shell` | foreground | No enforcement | Inline edits applied directly by the model without a tool call are not visible to Guard, and background sessions that run without an active terminal do not surface hook events. |
| zcode | `prompt` | foreground | No enforcement | Inline edits applied directly by the model without a tool call are not visible to Guard, and background sessions that run without an active terminal do not surface hook events. |
| zcode | `mcp_tool` | foreground | No enforcement | Inline edits applied directly by the model without a tool call are not visible to Guard, and background sessions that run without an active terminal do not surface hook events. |
| zcode | `file_read` | foreground | No enforcement | Inline edits applied directly by the model without a tool call are not visible to Guard, and background sessions that run without an active terminal do not surface hook events. |
| devin | `PreToolUse` | foreground | Stops the action | A source declaration does not prove that a live Devin session honored a deny response. |
| devin | `PermissionRequest` | foreground | Stops the action | Native approval UX and Guard evidence still require a live host/version check. |
| devin | `UserPromptSubmit` | foreground | Stops the action | Prompt screening does not prove downstream model or host request rewriting. |
| devin | `PostToolUse` | foreground | Records only | Post-tool observation does not block or replace model-visible output. |
| muse | `PreToolUse` | foreground | Stops the action | A source declaration does not prove that a live Muse session honored a deny response. |
| muse | `PermissionRequest` | foreground | Stops the action | Native approval UX and Guard evidence still require a live host/version check. |
| muse | `UserPromptSubmit` | foreground | Stops the action | Prompt screening does not prove downstream model or host request rewriting. |
| muse | `PostToolUse` | foreground | Records only | Post-tool observation does not block or replace model-visible output. |
| muse | `SessionStart` | foreground | Records only | Session context does not prove that later tool calls were reviewed. |
| muse | `Stop` | foreground | Records only | Stop observation does not prove that earlier tool calls were reviewed. |
| paseo | `*` | foreground | No enforcement | Protection is delegated to supported native providers on the Paseo daemon host. Paseo permission notifications are not blocking hooks. Terminals, daemon git/browser actions, plugin code, custom commands, ACP providers, relocated native homes, and remote hosts are not covered. Native runtime failure behavior and approval/resume support remain provider-specific. |
